description: KALI AUDIO IN-5 STUDIO MONITOR (EACH). Kali’s IN-Series monitors are some of the most innovative studio monitors ever made. description: The Riot-10 is built for solo performers, small bands, and DJs who need professional PA sound without complex setup. This powered 10-inch speaker delivers everything you need in one compact cabinet: amplification, mixing, DSP processing, and wireless connectivity. At its core, the Riot-10 combines a 500W peak low-frequency amplifier with a 200W peak high-frequency amplifier, driving a 10-inch woofer with 30oz magnet and 1-inch titanium compression driver. The result is full-range sound that covers 50Hz to 20kHz with 92dB sensitivity and 120dB maximum SPL. The onboard 2-channel mixer accepts microphones, instruments, and line sources through dual XLR/TRS combo inputs, while built-in Bluetooth handles wireless audio streaming. Digital signal processing with 96kHz sampling and 24-bit resolution optimizes the sound automatically, with manual DSP controls available via the LED display. The 2.3kHz crossover point ensures smooth frequency transition between drivers. This speaker handles small venues up to 150 people as a main PA, works as a floor monitor thanks to its angled cabinet design, or serves as a DJ booth monitor for club gigs. description: Boasting performance comparable to much larger systems, but in a compact package, the bi-amplified 8040B is ideal for use in many situations where a wide frequency response is needed but space is limited. Uses include nearfield monitoring, project/home studios, workstations, broadcast and TV control rooms and mobile production vehicles. The ingenious, flow optimized, reflex port achieves clear deep bass articulation with no compression or port noises. Combined with the advanced Genelec Directivity Control Waveguide (DCW) and the rounded edges and gently curved front and sides of the MDE (Minimum Diffraction Enclosure) enclosure, the result is an astoundingly wide, flat frequency response both on and off axis.
